title: Umthwalo Wengcebo
intro: Umi phambi kwendaba yengcebo enkulu, impilo ehlotshiswe ngegolide namandla, kodwa ekugcineni isifundo sokuxwayisa kubo bonke abafuna ubukhulu bomhlaba. Ungawuthola yini lo muntu ondaba yakhe izwakala ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ubufakazi bokuthi izinto zomhlaba zidlula ngokushesha?
clues: Ngangingumuntu woMprofethi omkhulu, kodwa ngakhetha indlela yokuzikhukhumeza nokucindezela.
U-Allah wangipha ingcebo enkulu, kangangokuthi izihluthulelo zengcebo yami zaba umthwalo osindayo eqenjini elinamandla lamadoda.
Abantu bami bangeluleka ukuthi ngingazigqaji ngengcebo yami, bengikhumbuza ukuthi u-Allah akamthandi umuntu ozigqajayo.
Ngazikhukhumeza ngokuthi ingcebo yami enkulu yayingenxa yolwazi lwami kanye nomzamo wami, hhayi isibusiso esivela ku-Allah.
Ngaxwayiswa ngenkohlakalo futhi ngakhunjuzwa ukuthi ngifune iLife Endlini Ezayo ngalokho u-Allah anginike khona, kodwa ngenqaba ukulalela futhi ngaqhubeka nokuqhosha kwami.
Ekugcineni, u-Allah wabangela ukuba umhlaba ungigwinye mina kanye nendawo yami yokuhlala, wangishiya ngingenabasizi abamelene nomyalo waKhe.
verse: So We caused the earth to swallow him and his home. And there was for him no body of supporters to aid him other than Allah, nor was he of those who could defend themselves. (Al-Qasas 28:81)
arabic: فَخَسَفْنَا بِهِ وَبِدَارِهِ الْأَرْضَ فَمَا كَانَ لَهُ مِن فِئَةٍ يَنصُرُونَهُ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُنتَصِرِينَ
